== PyLabRobot Key API Summary ==
- The main object is `lh` (LiquidHandler). All operations are methods of `lh`.
- All `lh` operations are asynchronous and MUST be awaited. e.g., `await lh.pick_up_tips(...)`.
- Getting resources: Use `lh.get_resource("resource_name")` to get a resource object from the deck.
- Core commands:
  - `await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack["A1"])`: Picks up tips from a specific spot.
  - `await lh.drop_tips(tip_rack["A1"])`: Drops tips back to a specific spot.
  - `await lh.aspirate(plate["A1"], vols=[100])`: Aspirates 100uL from well A1.
  - `await lh.dispense(plate["B1"], vols=[100])`: Dispenses 100uL into well B1.

    # Define the 8 wells (row A, columns 1-8) for the serial dilution
    wells = ["A1", "A2", "A3", "A4", "A5", "A6", "A7", "A8"]

    # Build an iterator over sequential tip positions on the tip rack
    # Order: A1, B1, C1, ..., H1, A2, B2, ... (96 positions total).
    # We will consume 15 tips: 1 for the sample transfer, then 2 per step for 7 steps.
    tip_positions = [f"{row}{col}" for col in range(1, 13) for row in "ABCDEFGH"]
    tip_iter = iter(tip_positions)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    # ================================================================
    # 96-well plate-to-plate transfer (source_plate -> destination_plate)
    # ================================================================

    # volume is kept below the tip maximum to leave headroom and avoid
    # over-aspiration / max-volume errors.

    # TIP BUDGET NOTE: 8 rows x 12 cols = 96 wells, which is exactly one
    # full 96-position tip rack. One tip is consumed per well, so the rack
    # is exhausted when the protocol finishes. Do not re-run this protocol
    # on the same deck without replenishing tip_rack_50ul.

    # --- Resource lookup (all resources are pre-configured on the deck) ---
    tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
    source_plate = lh.get_resource("source_plate")
    destination_plate = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")

    # --- Transfer parameters -------------------------------------------------
    ROWS = "ABCDEFGH"
    COLS = list(range(1, 13))
    TRANSFER_VOL = 40.0     # uL (< 50 uL tip capacity)
    MIX_VOL = 30.0          # uL
    MIX_CYCLES = 3          # aspirate/dispense cycles at the destination

    tips_used = 0

    # --- Column-wise transfer (A1 -> A1, ..., H12 -> H12) --------------------
    for col in COLS:
        for row in ROWS:
            well = f"{row}{col}"

            # 1) Fresh tip for every well so carry-over is impossible
            await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack[well])

            # 2) Pull sample from the source plate
            await lh.aspirate(source_plate[well], vols=[TRANSFER_VOL])

            # 3) Deliver into the destination plate
            await lh.dispense(destination_plate[well], vols=[TRANSFER_VOL])

                await lh.dispense(destination_plate[well], vols=[MIX_VOL])

            # 5) Return the tip to its original rack position
            await lh.drop_tips(tip_rack[well])

            tips_used += 1
            print(f"[transfer] {well}: {TRANSFER_VOL} uL moved ({tips_used}/96)")

    # --- Summary -------------------------------------------------------------
    print(
        f"Transfer complete: {tips_used} wells processed "
        f"(one tip per well from tip_rack_50ul)."
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Resource lookup - all four resources are pre-configured on the deck
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
    source = lh.get_resource("source_plate")
    dest = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Protocol parameters
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    transfer_volume = 40.0  # uL - kept below the 50 uL tip capacity
    source_wells = ["A1", "B1", "C1", "D1"]   # column 1 of the source plate
    dest_wells = ["A1", "B1", "C1", "D1"]     # column 1 of the destination plate
    tip_wells = ["A1", "B1", "C1", "D1"]      # one fresh tip per transfer

    if not (len(source_wells) == len(dest_wells) == len(tip_wells)):
        raise ValueError("source_wells, dest_wells and tip_wells must have equal length")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Main transfer loop: source -> destination, fresh tip for every well
    # (clean tip per well avoids any carry-over between samples)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
